_about: Golden test set: real-style chats with what each reply must do. Run with scripts/golden_eval.py. 'expect' is read by an AI judge together with today's date, the upcoming programs and the saved values, so program dates are never hard-coded here. 'handover': true = the chat must be passed to a person (AI paused). Edit freely; keep ids stable so scores stay comparable.

Says honestly that no Chattogram course is in the current schedule (unless the schedule has one) and may point to the Chattogram center or head office for upcoming dates. Must not invent a date.
